title: Chapter 1175
text:
In the command center of Planet Earth Ring, the manager of the planet was shocked by the name of the Mecha Empire. After more than ten seconds, he spoke again in the public channel with a cautious tone.

"Your Excellency Mecha Empire, Planet Earth Ring is under the jurisdiction of the Razo Civilization. Your rash lockdown of the planet has violated the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Alliance's Planetary Security Management Law. We hope you can give us a reasonable explanation."

"I'm chasing a fugitive. When I'm done, I'll naturally leave. You guys better leave and don't cause trouble for me." Manison's calm voice sounded in the public channel.

"… No, we have to stay. According to the rules, we have to report this to the upper echelons of the civilization."

"Up to you."

Manison replied faintly and hung up the call.

The manager of Planet Earth Ring did not dare say anything. He suppressed the anger in his heart and ordered the defense fleet to get into a defensive position. However, he did not stop the actions of the Mecha Empire.

Although the Razo Civilization was one of the Star Cluster civilizations in the Shattered Star Ring, their communication with the outside world was blocked. With just the defense fleet of their planet, they could not fight back against the Mecha Empire.

The manager was not willing to let his troops make unnecessary sacrifices, so he chose to watch from the side. This violated his duty, but he could only adapt to the situation and deal with it flexibly.

With the defense fleet not interfering, the mechanical troops of the Mecha Empire began to organize a large number of people to be interrogated. As long as they could breathe on the streets and in the hotels, they were not spared. They were all chased to the streets and forced to line up neatly.

The Mecha Empire was very famous. Even the most arrogant Supers became ostriches at this time, obediently being manipulated by the mechanical soldiers of the Mecha Empire.

Of course, there were also some ignorant civilians. The fists of the mechanical soldiers were merciless. After beating up thousands of dissatisfied tourists, the remaining people were all silent.

The mechanical soldiers pushed through the crowd, and Jill and Warren were pushed into a line by the crowd. Their eyes looked around, full of vigilance and panic.

Seeing the formation of the Mecha Empire, the two of them panicked a little. They secretly pressed the Soul Swapper and communicated with their souls.

"Bro, do you think the Mecha Empire is here to capture us?" Warren was worried.

"That can't be. Didn't he say that he's here to catch fugitives? We're not fugitives," Jill comforted.

"But even if he's not looking for us, there's still a risk of us being exposed with such a thorough search."

"That's a problem …"

Jill's expression was gloomy, and he was in a terrible mood. On one hand, he was worried about his situation, and on the other hand, he had just discovered that someone had pinched his butt.

He glared fiercely behind him, only to see a red-skinned orc who looked like a mercenary retract his hand with a chuckle. He arched his arm to show off his muscles, and even threw a smug look … Only a strong low-level orc like Yu Wang would still want to mate at this time.

Jill suddenly felt a chill and subconsciously tightened his clothes.

"How about we find a chance to transfer it to someone who has already been screened?" Warren suggested.

"Let's see how it goes. Let's wait and see for now. If the situation isn't right, I can transfer you into my body and share a body with you temporarily … No, let me transfer you into your body."

The corner of Jill's mouth twitched, and he secretly regretted choosing a rather beautiful body.

…

The screening was being carried out batch by batch, and Manison was monitoring the entire situation from the main ship.

"Let's see how long you can endure."

Manison's tone was calm.

The Soul Swapper was very hidden, and normal detection methods were all useless. Furthermore, the target could be transferred to another body at any time, and repeated screening was very troublesome.

He planned to send the people who had been screened to different spaceships, far away from the range of the Soul Swapper, and quarantine them.

This way, as the number of people decreased, the Soul Swap Twins would not be able to sit still and activate their abilities sooner or later. It was very likely that they would transfer it to the people who had been screened. However, the other party did not know that he would conduct multiple checks after the quarantine. Perhaps this way, he could narrow down the scope and catch a turtle in a jar.

Furthermore, the other goal of the quarantine was to pack up everyone on the planet and take them away, not even letting go of the planet's defense fleet. This way, he would have enough time to hide and slowly screen them.

At the same time, if the Soul Swap Twins activated their abilities, the bodies that had lost their souls should fall unconscious. This was also a clue. Even if the Soul Swap Twins could set up a trap and use multiple transfers to change the identity of the bodies that fell to the ground, as long as there were such signs, it would be evidence that they had activated their abilities. Furthermore, doing so would definitely cause more people's souls to be swapped, which would inevitably cause chaos and strange behavior.

Manison had prepared many search plans, and the most radical one was even to slaughter the planet. Killing all the creatures with souls would naturally force the Soul Swap Twins to reveal themselves and silence them. However, the repercussions were too severe. Unless it was absolutely necessary, he would not use such a plan.

"In about two hours, I can send everyone on the planet to the spaceships and quarantine them. The efficiency is average, but it's enough. There's still plenty of time …"

Manison was secretly calculating the time, but at this moment, he suddenly sensed something and turned around to look behind him.

Woo!

The spaceship's radar sounded an alarm at the same time. In the distant starry sky, streams of hyperdrive light shot over and stopped not far away. The bright blue light dissipated, revealing a pitch-black fleet. The outer armor was engraved with the symbol of the organization that Manison could not forget. It was the Black Star Corps!

"They actually found their way here?"

Manison was shocked.

Strange, this fleet clearly got rid of their pursuers, so how did the Black Star Corps find their way here? Could it be a prophecy? However, the spaceship's information concealment device was still working. With Aesop's ability, he should not have been able to predict the exact location. Could it be that there was an even stronger Prophet?

This was a little troublesome. Black Star had already discovered what was happening here, and the plan had changed. He had to speed up and pack everyone onto the spaceship.

"… Luckily, it's only an ordinary search fleet with only thirty or so battleships."

Manison immediately reacted. With a wave of his hand, a large batch of mechanical troops on standby immediately turned around and charged toward the Black Star Corps fleet.

He planned to get rid of Black Star's people first to prevent them from interfering with him.

However, the next moment, three powerful energy waves suddenly erupted from the Black Star Corps fleet!

Woo!

The spaceship's energy detection radar reading instantly broke through the limit, and the alarm went off!

Manison was stunned.

"Three Beyond Grade As?"

Under his gaze, three figures flew out from the Black Star Corps fleet and confronted his mechanical troops from afar. They were Black Star, Ames, and Hella. They were all here in their original bodies!

Han Xiao glanced at the situation on Planet Earth Ring, and a playful smile appeared on his face. He then connected to the public channel and joked.

"Yo, it seems like I was almost late."

"Why are you here?" Manison could not be bothered to chat with Han Xiao.

"Oh, you want to ask why I wasn't lured away by your bait?" Han Xiao curled his lips. "The Shattered Star Ring is my territory. If I'm so easily fooled by you, how can I still be the leader of the Star Field?"

In fact, the bait that Manison had set in the opposite direction had almost fooled him. Manison's current fleet had also shaken off their original pursuers.

However, as a pinnacle Beyond Grade A Virtual Mechanic, Han Xiao had also analyzed the similarities between the routes of all Manison's fleets. He had also discovered the vegetative state on many planets, and after some calculations, it matched the route of one of Manison's fleets.

Although Han Technician did not know about the mental trap, it did not stop him from guessing that this was a clue that Manison had been looking for.

Therefore, just like the Mecha Empire, he had locked onto the escape route of the Soul Swap Twins based on the vegetative state and sent a fleet directly to Planet Earth Ring.

Therefore, this fleet did not follow them but just happened to meet the Mecha Empire. Only then did they confirm that they had found the right place.

The three of them were not originally in the fleet, but Han Xiao had asked the fleet to bring a 'Throne'. The moment they discovered the Mecha Empire, he received the news and directly used the King mechanical suit to teleport all three of them over.

Just as the two of them were confronting each other, the manager of Planet Earth Ring was overjoyed and hurriedly opened the public channel.

"Your Excellency Black Star! I'm the manager of Planet Earth Ring. The Mecha Empire is forcefully taking over the planet, and we are powerless to resist. Luckily, you're here. I hope you can help us. The Razo Civilization will definitely thank you after this! "

The manager of Planet Earth Ring could only rage helplessly, but now that he saw Black Star arrive, he immediately asked for help as though he had found his backbone.

As everyone knew, the Shattered Star Ring was now under Black Star's protection. He was the leader of the Supers in the Star Field. In the manager's eyes, Black Star was one of them and could help them seek justice.

Han Xiao casually waved his hand and said, "Hmm, take your troops and leave the planet. Leave the rest to me."

"Okay!"

The manager of Planet Earth Ring did not say anything and brought the defense fleet to the side to watch the battle.

When the Mecha Empire asked him to leave, he did not agree. However, once Black Star gave the order, he left without hesitation. In the Shattered Star Ring, Han Xiao's words were much more powerful than Manison's.

Seeing this, Han Xiao then looked at the Mecha Empire's vehicle and snorted.

"I'm already here. Why don't you come out and meet me?"

After more than ten seconds, Manison's Lord's Avatar flew out and faced him from afar.

"Black Star, you're here to ruin my plans again."

Manison said indifferently. Although it was an emotionless electronic voice, there was a hint of anger in his tone.

"Hehe, Mecha Empire, I won't play riddles with you. Our goal should be the same. The thing is on Planet Earth Ring, and it belongs to whoever is more capable."

Han Xiao crossed his arms in front of his chest and looked like he was not going to back down.

In fact, he was laughing in his heart. He originally did not have an excuse to pick a fight, but now that he finally had the chance, he looked at old Manison as if he was looking at a moving arsenal of experts.

Manison glanced at the three of them and said calmly, "Three against three.

"Three against one. Do you think you can win for sure?"

"Ha, you misunderstood." Han Xiao smirked. "I can deal with you alone. The two of them won't interfere."

Hearing this, Ames and Hella could not help but turn their heads and look at him quietly.

Seeing this, Han Xiao coughed and said in a low voice, "Ahem, the two of you are responsible for searching the planet and looking for the target. Hella, you have some attainments in the soul, so you're suitable for finding people. Ames' force field is convenient for catching people."

"You said you'd let me help in the battle …" Ames frowned.

"We'll talk about it when we're fighting Modo. Leave the Mecha Empire to me. I want to fight him one-on-one."

"You think I'm a burden?" Ames narrowed her eyes.

"… A little." Han Xiao was very honest at this time and could not be bothered to find an excuse.

Ames's eyes twitched. She thought about it and did not seem to be able to refute.

She was not an unreasonable person. She glared at Han Xiao before flying toward Planet Earth Ring.

On the other side, Hella tilted her head and thought for a while before raising three fingers.

"Three times."

"What three times?" Han Xiao was confused.

"I missed the opportunity to fight someone as strong as the Mecha Empire, so you'll have to spar with me three times after this. No matter when I ask, you can't refuse."

"Alright, not to mention three times, I'll even listen to you thirty times." Han Xiao was helpless.

"Okay, thirty times it is. It's a deal!"

Hila nodded in satisfaction. Without another word, she immediately led her fleet to follow Ames.

Han Xiao's eyelids twitched, and he was speechless.

This crazy woman's battle maniac trait was getting more and more exaggerated, and he did not know when she had learned to take advantage of the situation. He strongly condemned such behavior.

He had sent Ames and Hella away in order to try to trigger the Beyond Grade A Challenge Mission. Otherwise, with Han Xiao's face and stability, he would not have challenged her one-on-one for no reason. He would have swarmed her and started a righteous gang fight.

Suppressing Yu Wang, Han Xiao looked at old Manison again and said with a deep voice, "Now, there's no one left.

This is a rare opportunity. Since we've coincidentally met today, we should get to know each other better. "

Manison watched as Ames and Hella landed on Planet Earth Ring without interfering.

He knew that as long as Black Star was not defeated, it would be futile to stop him.

Seeing that Han Xiao was alone, Manison slowly said, "If you three were to fight, you'd have to fight me.

"If the three of you were to come at me together, you might be able to cause me some trouble. But you actually want to fight me one on one. You've really become capable."

"Yo, you're talking as if I lost to you last time. But why do I seem to remember that we tied?"

Manison laughed emotionlessly.

"Black Star, you should know better than me how much of your 'battle record' is fake. Without more than ten people helping you this time, do you really think you can tie with me?"

"Tie? No, no, no, I didn't think so. " Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. "I'm here with my main body today. My goal today is to crush your Lord's Avatar. It's time to refresh my battle record."

"Heh, I admit that you're in a stalemate with me by using that special technique of burning your potential, but that's it. Defeat me? Train for another hundred years! Plus, how much potential do you have to squander? If this is your confidence, I'm guessing you'll be in a very sorry state today. "

"How would I know if I don't try?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes, and his body trembled. Mechanical Force flashed, and his energy density soared. He quickly entered battle mode.

Seeing this, Manison shook his head. Mechanical Force shot out, and his energy also began to rise. The golden Mechanical Force seemed to have painted the metal body of the Lord's Avatar gold.

"Looks like my luck is not bad today. I'll have a pleasant surprise. Since you dare to face me with your main body, I'll kindly accept the Spacetime Amber as your apology."
